messages:
maya: Heads-up — QA noticed our trace-derived latency SLO shows big spikes after the rollout yesterday. Not sure if it's real or introduced by sampling changes.
kevin: Do you have an example route? I can pull spans.
maya: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings both. Spans look heavier for `decoder.step` segments.
zara: Could be the new quantized model fallback we enabled for cold-starts — longer decode time for short sequences.
drew: That would increase tail latency but shouldn't change p50 much. Are spikes in p99/p999?
maya: Mostly p99 and p999, p50 stable. Here's the dashboard link (redacted): https://console/redwood/ds/trace/slo/abc 
kevin: Quick note — our OTEL exporter changed to probabilistic tail sampling last week (config updated in prod). That can bias derived SLOs if the sampling weight tracks latency.
zara: Right. We intentionally biased to capture tail spans for model decode, but I didn't think about how the dashboard aggregation assumes uniform sampling.
drew: Two problems: (1) retention/backfill math is off if samples are weighted, (2) the SLO UI expects absolute counts to compute error budget burn.
maya: UX asks: do we show sampled-adjusted SLO (estimate true latency) or show raw observed (what we measured)? Product wants both?
zara: For internal ops I'd prefer adjusted estimates plus a confidence band. For external SLA customers we must show raw, since that's auditable.
kevin: Implementation proposal: exporter tags each span with sampling.weight and sampling.policy. Then telemetry pipeline can reweight when producing derived metrics. We already store attributes but not used in SLO pipeline.
drew: That works if we keep weights small (float). Also need to update the retention exporter: aggregated counts must store sum(weights) not count(spans).
maya: Any perf/cost concerns? Reweighting in the pipeline could be expensive at ingest-time.
zara: We can do approximate reweighting in streaming layer (Windowed aggregation) and run an exact job in nightly job to recompute SLOs for the last 24h for accuracy.
kevin: For dashboard UX: show a small banner when SLOs are reweighted: "Derived SLOs are sampling-adjusted — see details" with hover explaining method + last recompute timestamp.
drew: Also add a toggle on rollout pages to switch metric view between raw and adjusted. Helps PMs when comparing model variants during canary.
maya: Good call. Can we also add a lightweight probe: synthetic trace that exercises decoder path so we can detect instrumentation regressions?
zara: We have synthetic requests, but not synthetic spans for internal decode steps. I'll add a small job that emits annotated spans every 5m.
kevin: I'll send a PR to add sampling.weight -> metrics pipeline mapping. Will add unit tests and perf benchmark.
drew: I'll open a console ticket for the banner + toggle + canary integration.
maya: Thanks team. If we reweight, let's document semantics in SLO playbook (how error-budget is computed).
alert-bot: Incident note created: 2026-06-15T10:12:03Z — Created ticket PLATFORM-642 for derived-SLO sampling adjustments.
kevin: FYI — I'll postpone the reweight rollout until we have the synthetic spans and the UI toggle in place.
maya: Sounds good. We'll circle back after PRs. :thumbsup:
